release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD4167T-9 is a thermographic thermal and optical bi-spectrum network speed dome with a 640x512 VOx thermal module (9 mm wide-angle lens), a 4 MP 40x optical channel and high-accuracy temperature measurement from -20 to 550 C. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1, thermal is Channel 2.
